diagram_a_hexagonal:
Designer / CLI [driving]
        |
   (read-only) Export / Project Module HTML
        v
HOST application (orchestration only)
   |              |               |
FS read      SPEC model.rs    report render
   ^         (ModuleSpec)          ^
product .ess   packet.rs      this module.html
               GUARD/EVID [reference only — unresolved in A]
Product files = design authority; SPEC = approval authority;
Packet/HTML = derived; never write authority.

tests.status: NOT RUN (planning definitions for TDD Gate)

categories.normal: Regenerate HTML from unchanged approved sources → CURRENT; embed ModuleSpec draft + trace rows.
categories.boundary: Empty BDD/TDD on a node → row omitted or explicit empty arrays; missing optional work/design still projects.
categories.invalid: Missing required source path in SOURCES list → generator fails closed; no partial READY claim.
categories.dependency_failure: Unreadable approved packet → hard error; do not invent inventory.
categories.partial_failure: One source unreadable → whole projection fails (no half-current HTML). If module.html write fails after module.json write, roll back JSON to prior pair.
categories.state: Draft revision never auto-flips to approved; readiness of referenced packet stays NOT_READY.
categories.transaction: Publish module.json + module.html as a pair: backup prior bytes, write both, on any write failure restore prior pair (no new-JSON/old-HTML).
categories.lifecycle: Refresh after source edit → PROJECTION_STALE until regenerate; evidence_refs stay empty until owner EVID; plain pointers under evidence.
categories.regression: SPEC sample_module_spec.json still loads; A fixture payload_sha256 unchanged; no production edits.

tests.intended_red: Independent TDD may add a compile-able check that fails when bound_source_sha256 mismatches current bytes or when HTML lacks contracts/tests/scope/evidence/risk/diagrams.
